description: Retrieves the user action for the given Id. If you pass in null for the Id, this will return all the user actions.

X-FusionAuth-TenantId.description: The unique Id of the tenant used to scope this API request. Only required when there is more than one tenant and the API key is not tenant-scoped.

userActionId.description: The Id of the user action.

name: retrieveUserActionWithId
